summary.text: Kathryn Buckley is the Republican candidate for the Pennsylvania House of Representatives, District 168, in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Democratic incumbent Lisa Borowski.
She ran for the same seat in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Kathryn Buckley was the Republican nominee for District 168 in 2024, when Borowski defeated her, 58.0% to 41.8%.
She advanced from the Republican primary on May 19, 2026, setting up a rematch with Borowski.
